correctness.rationale: Exact character-orthogonality decomposition into equal-pole and unequal-pole cases yields W=3 delta_T[(-1)^m 2^z-1]+9 delta_special. For each leaf frequency vector the balanced pole choices split 1:2, giving the entire signed multiplicity distribution. Only A_0 and B_1 vanish additionally, both when n is even. Integer parity and powers of two show exact gaps 3/9; W(0)=3(2^n+2) and finite-group convolution diagonalization prove the rank and pseudoinverse claims. Independent integer phase-count enumeration checked every balanced Fourier multiplier for n=1..6 and histogram totals for larger n; computations are corroboration rather than an infinite proof.
